mapper.select: select sec.Sec_Name as secName, sec.Sec_Type as secType, sec.Sec_Organize_Form as secOrganizeForm, sec.Sec_Bidding_Type as secBiddingType, sec.Sec_Start_Time as secStartTime, sec.Sec_End_Time as secEndTime, sec.Sec_Bidding_Cycle as secBiddingCycle, sec.Sec_Place as secPlace, sec.Sec_Other_Valuation as secOtherValuation, sec.Sec_Pricing_Method as secPricingMethod, sec.Sec_Trading_Place as secTradingPlace, sec.Sec_Money as secMoney, c1.C_Name as tendereeName, c2.C_Name as secAgencyName, mn.* from Sec_QE_Pre_Trial mn left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on c1.C_ID=sec.Sec_Tenderee left join Sys_Company c2 on c2.C_Id=sec.Sec_Agency where mn.id=#{id}
